decisions.reason: Organic sliced ham fits our core premium deli range and our stated push to expand organic lines, with broad enough retailer and consumer demand to justify staying in the assortment.
Organic sliced cured smoked pork is a narrower niche than ham or salami and, without signs of sustained prominence after launch, is a sensible SKU to cut in favor of stronger core items.
Organic pepper-coated salami is close to our established strengths, supports the organic range, and serves a popular self-service salami segment with premium differentiation.
The beef in teriyaki aspic looks like an experimental deli-counter specialty and is too niche to merit ongoing resources compared with more dependable traditional products.
Fennel-flavoured sliced salami adds distinctive premium variety within a familiar category and its dedicated presentation suggests it has a stronger role in the assortment than a short-term trial.
Liver pâté with veal matches our traditional premium positioning, uses existing processing know-how efficiently, and broadens the pâté offer with a classic upscale variant.
